facts.business: Cyient is a global lifecycle engineering company providing digital engineering and technology services across aerospace, rail, automotive, connectivity, utilities, mining, energy, healthcare, and semiconductors.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Accelerating large-deal momentum through deeper engagement with strategic accounts and disciplined cross-sell across verticals
Embedding intelligence into the engineering core through proprietary AI accelerators, partnerships and platform-based delivery
Strengthening global delivery and talent capabilities to support long-term scalability

key_risks: Ongoing Middle East conflict threatening global growth, energy prices and trade flows
Pace and shape of AI-driven productivity resets compressing effort-based revenue
Intensifying competition from Global Capability Centres
Client caution on discretionary R&D spend
Geopolitical, technological, regulatory, and climate-related shifts
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were entered into in the ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis. The Company has complied with the provisions of section 188(1) of the Act dealing with related party transactions.
